title: Research with AI
description: Generic research prompt for an Idea, Claim, or Question in the user's tree, with a paste-back step that nests new points under the current node.

variables.name: nodeType
variables.description: Type of the node being researched; changes the framing, closing ask, and root marker.

variables.name: ancestorLines
variables.description: Ancestor nodes from tree root to parent, each formatted as `label: text`.

variables.name: currentText
variables.description: Text of the node being researched.

variables.name: childLines
variables.description: Text of the node's direct children.

surfaces: My Vision → Options → Research with AI (`general_research`: an Idea or Claim under a civic scope)

usage.notes: The root bullet is the current node text with its type marker appended when missing.
